title: HTTP Datagram and Capsule Protocol Foundation Work Item
summary: Add trace-owned HTTP/3 Datagram and Capsule Protocol foundation behavior for RFC 9297.
planned_changes:
- Add HTTP Datagram encode/parse helpers for Quarter Stream ID and payload bytes.
- Add SETTINGS_H3_DATAGRAM typed settings support, default metadata, validation, local/peer send gating, and 0-RTT nondecreasing validation.
- Add H3_DATAGRAM_ERROR and SETTINGS_H3_DATAGRAM registered constants.
- Add Capsule Protocol Type/Length/Value encoding and parsing with unknown-capsule skipping and DATAGRAM Capsule type 0x00 support.
- Add focused positive, negative, and edge tests plus canonical SpecTrace xrefs.
verification_plan: Run the HTTP/3 package build, focused RFC9297 foundation tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full solution test before commit.
completion_notes: The RFC 9297 byte-level HTTP Datagram, SETTINGS_H3_DATAGRAM, H3_DATAGRAM_ERROR, and base Capsule/DATAGRAM Capsule foundations are implemented and ready for the later policy and MASQUE slices.
